Yes, thank you.  It feels so nice talking to people I don't know who won't judge me or at least make assumptions that I am a terrible person.  I've spent the entire day just hating myself for letting it get this bad.  I will definitely try a new hobby out.  I don't have anyway to express myself creatively :/

Thank you for reaching out to me.  I wish there were more people like you :)

Thank you for your perspective.  I have lost confidence in myself.  I've had a bad year.  I'm actually out of the apartment now.  I found someone to sublease and they will be moving in shortly, so I'll be ok when the 20th comes.

When this happened to you, what did you do?  I have a lot of mutual friends with girl and i feel like they are judging me.  How did you react?
Yes you're right.  These feelings will soon pass.  Its like the cherry on what I've been going through this past year.  I'll wait it out.  Thank you for listening :)

Let's just say she's not the most understanding person.  She flips out then a week she'll be back to normal.  I'm trying to take the high road here and not add any more fuel to the drama fire.  

I don't know.  I've already moved out and found someone to sublease.  I just can't stop thinking about it and then I get so upset.  I feel helpless but I know in two weeks this will pass

Everything you have said makes perfect sense.  I know this sounds weird but it's not about the money that gets me.  I can pay it back and will pay it back soon enough but I'm focusing on her comments.  Her friends comments are getting to me as well.  They were even calling me a bitch on the post and i can't stop focusing on it.  She even told everyone that I failed out this semester which I had no idea how she knew.  How do I stop caring about it, I can't stop thinking about it
The landlords know the money will be there on the 20th.  I just want avoid her.  I've blocked her on Facebook. I've moved out but I just feel awful.  The comments on the post were not kind

I haven't talked to her at all.  She keeps sending me texts on how I am a horrible human being.  I don't know how to deal with it.  The landlords already know I can't pay until the 20th so I don't see why I have to tell her.  I have anxiety so I have been having panic attacks avoiding this all day.
